source: Natural Earth 1:10m Land (ne_10m_land), public domain, naturalearthdata.com
processing: Clipped to bounds, simplified 0.0035 deg, islets < 0.0002 sq deg removed, holes (lakes) filled. Not for navigation.
land_rule: 255: navigable, no land in any part of the cell (1/4 cell precision); 128: approach-only, water covers at least half of the cell; 0: land
